description_en: Deletes department information based on the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID and department ID
description_zh: 根据AICCS实例ID、部门ID删除部门信息
name: DeleteDepartment

parameters.help_en:
The AICCS instance ID.  
You can obtain it from **Instance Management** in the left-side navigation pane of the [Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在[智能联络中心控制台](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The department ID.  

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2717975.html API and check the **DepartmentId** field in the response to obtain the department ID
parameters.help_zh:
部门ID。

可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2717975.html接口，查看返回参数的**DepartmentId**，即部门ID
parameters.name: department_id
